item.title: “Consider alternative livelihoods,” Zoho’s Vembu tells software developers
item.description: Zoho Chief Scientist Sridhar Vembu says rapid progress in AI-assisted coding means developers should start considering alternative livelihoods. He cites examples of AI building complex software and outlines both hopeful and dystopian futures for an AI-driven economy.

item.title: Saudi Pro League warns Cristiano Ronaldo over transfer protest
item.description: The Portuguese star footballer Cristiano Ronaldo has received a warning from the Saudi Pro League amid a dispute over transfer spending.

item.title: RBI to compensate digital fraud victims up to Rs 25,000: Protecting citizens
item.description: Amid the growing use of digital payments, many people are getting trapped in new scams. Keeping this threat in mind, the RBI has proposed measures to increase security in digital transactions so that people’s safety can be ensured and potential losses can be avoided. Along with this, the RBI will provide financial assistance to affected customers.

item.title: Madras High Court upholds Rs 1.5 crore penalty on actor Vijay for concealing ‘Puli’ income
item.description: The Madras High Court dismissed Vijay’s petition, confirming the Income Tax Department’s ₹1.5 crore penalty for ₹15 crore in undisclosed income from Puli. A 2015 raid at his Chennai home uncovered ₹4.93 crore in unreported cash payments on top of cheque amounts, leading to the penalty under search-related provisions.

item.title: A common lifestyle loophole: Is sitting REALLY the new smoking?
item.description: Relying solely on a gym session to “fix” a day of sitting isn’t enough. NEAT—Non-Exercise Activity Thermogenesis—includes all the small movements you do throughout the day, from fidgeting to pacing to climbing stairs. These everyday actions keep your body “kinetic” and more resistant to the metabolic changes that increase cancer risk.

item.title: Why Indian Army is renaming 246 roads, buildings and facilities across country
item.description: The Indian Army has embarked on a significant initiative to rename 246 colonial-era roads, buildings, and facilities nationwide. This move aims to foster an institutional identity rooted in India’s own history, ethos, and military traditions, while paying tribute to gallantry awardees and war heroes. The renaming underscores a national commitment to honour the valour and sacrifice of Indian soldiers, reflecting India’s rich military legacy.

item.title: ‘Paid promotion’: Delhi Police dispel missing girls reports, warn of action for ‘creating panic’ for money
item.description: The Delhi Police further warned of strict action against individuals involved in creating panic for money. It is also considering filing an FIR in connection with the matter.

item.title: MSME: Collateral-free loans to be doubled from Rs 10 lakh to Rs 20 lakh, says RBI guv
item.description: The MSMEs will be given double the amount of collateral-free loan compared to what they get now, the RBI governor has said on Feb 6. He has also said that banks could be lending money to REITs within by observing certain safeguards.

item.title: Grand Tour is back: Amazon Prime Video ropes in three new hosts
item.description: The Grand Tour have three new hosts, as Amazon Prime Video continues the beloved motoring show following Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond and James May ending their hosting duties.

item.title: Telangana government will bring hate speech law in budget session, says Revanth Reddy
item.description: The CM said that the law would along the lines of Karnataka’s Hate Speech and Crime (Prevention) Bill, 2025.
